components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The filled action that carries the main next step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--violet); color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #7043f0; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, opacity; transition-duration: 120ms; transition-timing-function: ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover, .ds-button-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Action

components.name: Quiet Action

components.css: .ds-button-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { background: #111114; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-quiet:active { transform: translateY(0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-quiet { transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, opacity; transition-duration: 120ms; transition-timing-function: ease; } .ds-button-quiet:hover, .ds-button-quiet:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A dark, quiet field for finding a device or sample row.
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #2d2d33; border-radius: 9px; background: #0c0c0f; color: #84848b; font: 400 10px/1.3 var(--font-ui); transition: border-color .16s ease; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #e7e7e9; font: 400 10px/1.4 var(--font-ui); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #77777e; } .ds-search-field > svg { flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-search-field:focus-within { border-color: #7354cf; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { caret-color: var(--amber); }

components.name: Active Dashboard Link
components.description: The selected destination in the workspace rail or mobile drawer.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: #929299; font: 400 12px/1.2 var(--font-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: color .16s ease, background .16s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #111114; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: rgba(128,82,255,.12); color: #f3efff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, opacity; transition-duration: 120ms; transition-timing-function: ease; } }

components.name: Demo Status
components.description: A persistent marker that distinguishes sample readings from live measurements.
components.css: .ds-demo-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,184,41,.22); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,184,41,.055); color: #e9b84f; font: 600 8px/1.2 var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: .08em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-demo-pill i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber); }

components.name: Data Panel
components.description: A restrained container that groups related dashboard measurements.
components.css: .ds-data-panel { padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid #25252a; border-radius: 15px; background: #09090b; color: #e7e7ea; } .ds-data-panel h3 { margin: 0; font: 550 13px/1.3 var(--font-ui); } .ds-data-panel p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #85858c; font: 400 9px/1.5 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Energy Chart
components.description: A responsive violet line chart with focusable points and an explicit simulated-data caption.
components.css: .ds-energy-chart { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 19px 20px 14px; border: 1px solid #25252a; border-radius: 15px; background: #09090b; color: #e7e7ea; } .ds-chart-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-chart-heading strong { font: 550 13px/1.3 var(--font-ui); } .ds-chart-heading span { color: #85858c; font: 400 9px/1.3 var(--font-ui); } .ds-chart { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; margin-top: 12px; overflow: visible; } .ds-chart-grid { fill: none; stroke: #25252b; stroke-width: 1; } .ds-chart-line { fill: none; stroke: #9a7aff; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-chart-point { fill: #101014; stroke: #b7a2ff; stroke-width: 1.7; cursor: crosshair; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-chart-point:hover { fill: var(--violet); stroke: #e0d6ff; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-chart-point:focus-visible { outline: none; stroke: var(--amber); stroke-width: 3; } .ds-energy-chart figcaption { margin-top: 7px; color: #77777e; font: 600 8px/1.3 var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: .08em; }

narrative.overview: The interface makes a shop’s electricity costs legible as a path: from a bill-level total, through appliance readings, to a useful next action. The landing page preserves the Dala-inspired black-void composition and oversized type, then gives that space a code-drawn energy constellation. Its generous opening and asymmetric text-and-visual balance make the energy story feel clear before the visitor enters the product.\n\nInside the dashboard, the same dark field becomes a measured workspace. Compact labels, tabular readings, fine dividers, and restrained panels help owners compare use and estimated cost. Readings, estimates, and preliminary insights remain visibly identified as simulated; the interface does not imply live device integration or verified savings.
keyCharacteristics: A black-void canvas with white and silver Inter typography.
Violet for action and measurement, amber for caution or emphasis, and teal for positive status.
Open, oversized landing typography paired with a compact, scannable dashboard.
Authored SVG energy visuals and clearly labeled simulated data.

rules.name: The Three Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep violet for action or measurement, amber for caution or emphasis, and teal for positive status. Do not swap these roles for decoration.

rules.name: The Scale Carries the Headline Rule
rules.body: Keep display and major headings at regular weight; use size and tracking for emphasis rather than bold weight.

rules.name: The Landing Trace Rule
rules.body: Preserve the landing page’s path from bill-level uncertainty to appliance-level visibility; keep this open composition distinct from the dashboard’s denser work surface.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat at rest. Use tonal separation and borders to establish structure instead of adding shadow.

rules.name: The Demo Clarity Rule
rules.body: Every sample reading, estimated cost, and preliminary insight stays visibly marked as simulated or demo data.

dos: Do keep the black void, Inter typography, and Electric Iris as the central landing identity.
Do reserve amber for caution or emphasis and teal for positive status.
Do use whitespace on the landing page and thin dividers with restrained panels in the dashboard.
Do keep simulated readings, estimates, and preliminary insights visibly labeled.
Do use tabular numerals for measured values and preserve responsive stacking for dense data.
Do keep gradients inside restrained data visualizations rather than using them as decorative fills.
donts: Don't present simulated readings or preliminary insights as live telemetry or verified outcomes.
Don't turn the landing page into a generic SaaS hero followed by a feature-card grid.
Don't use decorative shadows or large saturated-color surfaces.
Don't use decorative gradients on controls or general surfaces.
Don't use the violet, amber, and teal signal roles interchangeably.
Don't introduce raster photography or stock imagery into the energy visualization.
